answer: Each epoch samples 4 percent of submissions for full re-execution. Disagreement dilutes: if 2 of 5 auditors report different output, the payout splits across all 5 and no seat gets full credit. Vesting holds 70 percent of every reward against the next 10 epochs of work. Auditing 1,000 fake answers costs 1,000 re-executions plus collateral locked through the vesting window. A relic of an old thread does not survive the sample, and a knoll of empty seats pays the audit bill either way.
